features.name: age_z_clipped
features.description: Training-fold standardized age with clipping to reduce outlier leverage while retaining customer life-stage information.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth centered numeric axis that a linear SVM can weight directly.

features.name: age_deviation_score
features.description: Absolute departure from the training-fold typical age, scaled by the observed upper-side deviation; high values flag unusually young or old clients.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a simple way to use age extremes without relying on a purely monotone age effect.

features.name: education_code_z_clipped
features.description: Training-fold standardized education code using the stored numeric encoding.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth socioeconomic proxy without expanding into many sparse indicators.

features.name: credit_commitment_load_score
features.description: Scaled sum of default, housing, and loan codes; higher values indicate more encoded credit or obligation signals when the training codebook treats larger codes as heavier commitments.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses several related credit fields into one continuous pressure measure for a stable linear weight.

features.name: campaign_log_burden_score
features.description: Log-scaled count of contacts in the current outreach sequence; higher values indicate more repeated effort.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns a heavy-tailed count into a bounded fatigue and persistence signal suitable for a linear margin.

features.name: prior_contact_recency_score
features.description: Maps pdays to a 0-1 recency measure; 999 or larger is treated as no recent prior contact.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth recency axis that separates recent familiarity from no recent interaction.

features.name: prior_contact_volume_score
features.description: Log-scaled amount of earlier outreach recorded in previous.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures prior engagement intensity with diminishing returns and bounded scale.

features.name: prior_history_composite_score
features.description: A bounded average of recency, earlier-contact volume, and the stored poutcome code.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates one dense relationship-history projection that can be weighted cleanly by a linear SVM.
features.formula: np.clip((np.where(pdays >= 999, 0.0, np.clip((365.0 - pdays) / 365.0, 0.0, 1.0)) + np.clip(np.log1p(previous) / np.log1p(6.0), 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip(poutcome / 2.0, 0.0, 1.0)) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: contact_channel_score
features.description: Preserves the binary contact-channel code as a bounded numeric feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the margin to learn a direct offset for the communication channel.

features.name: economic_rate_ease_score
features.description: Inverts euribor3m to a 0-1 rate-ease proxy using training-fold observed endpoints; higher values indicate a lower interest-rate setting.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms the rate environment into a monotone affordability axis with bounded scale.

features.name: employment_stability_judgment
features.description: A 0-1 semantic assessor score from job, education, age, and marital using only the training codebook for category meanings; higher means steadier earning capacity and lower occupation-related uncertainty.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses job and household semantics into one continuous margin-friendly axis.

features.name: contact_context_quality_judgment
features.description: A 0-1 semantic assessor score from contact, month, day_of_week, campaign, pdays, previous, poutcome, and euribor3m; higher means the outreach situation appears timely, reachable, and not over-contacted.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets a linear SVM use expert timing and fatigue cues that may not be captured by simple ordinal codes.
